newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News completes US$1 bln pref. issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News completes US$1 bln pref. issue.

text.p: The News Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it had completed the sale of US$1 billion of preferred securities for the purchase of stock in British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc.

News Corp said the exchangeable trust originated preferred securities ("Exchangeable TOPrS") were sold to institutions and represented interests in subordinated debt and warrants to purchase 92.64 million ordinary shares in BSkyB.
The exercise price of the warrants represented a 20 percent premium to the latest closing price of BSkyB's ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange, it said.

News Corp will not have to deliver BSkyB shares or its American Depositary Shares upon exercise of the warrants but may deliver cash instead. It said the TOPrS provide an annual cash dividend of five percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
